continuity_scope: Dungeon World original core rules (2012; copyright Sage LaTorra and Adam Koebel), as represented by the official Dungeon World site's original-game description and its Creative Commons Attribution licensing statement. This is an emergent, player-generated-fiction rules source, not a fixed setting or franchise cast. It excludes Dungeon World 2 development material, supplements, third-party hacks, actual-play fiction, streamed/recorded games, and home campaigns.

work_or_witnesses.edition: Original 2012 core rules; copyright credits name Sage LaTorra and Adam Koebel.
Official original-game overview and licensing statement.

coverage_rule: Terms-only emergent-fiction audit. The selected core rules provide procedures for collaboratively creating adventurers, situations, and world details, not a bounded canonical dramatic cast. No character or relationship records are made. Playbooks/classes, moves, bonds, alignment/drives, fronts, monsters, items, places, and rules remain dimensions/terms. A named example or actual-play character is excluded unless a separate official witness directly profiles it as a stable dramatic individual independent of a particular table's play.
omissions: All named example characters, pre-generated characters, actual-play characters, and player-created adventurers, because they are not a stable official dramatic cohort in this rules pass.
All playbooks/classes, moves, bonds, alignment/drives, fronts, monsters, items, places, and rules as character nodes.
Dungeon World 2 development/alpha material, supplemental books, hacks, third-party works licensed under CC BY, actual-play fiction, streaming/recording outcomes, and home campaigns.
content_cautions: The official game frame includes fantasy danger, monsters, dungeons, combat, weapons, injury, death, treasure-seeking, and potentially frightening or oppressive situations. Tables should establish safety tools and boundaries suited to their participants.

Because the rules invite groups to create fiction, content and character relations are table-specific. A procedure or sample is not consent for any group to introduce harm, romance, prejudice, religious imagery, or other sensitive material without agreement.
uncertainties: The official Dungeon World site now also publishes Dungeon World 2 development posts. Those materials expressly distinguish DW1/original Dungeon World and are excluded from this 2012-core witness.

The original text's CC Attribution license permits derivatives, including commercial work. Permission to derive material does not make hacks, supplements, or actual-play fiction canonical to the original core source.

No dated, consolidated official errata document for the 2012 core rules was identified in this restricted witness set. No informal FAQ, hack revision, or later DW2 change is treated as original-core errata.
evidence_basis: Official Dungeon World site and original core PDF only. The official overview calls Dungeon World a tabletop RPG, describes classic-fantasy adventurers, play to find out what happens, moves, fronts, Agenda, and its CC Attribution license. The original core PDF supplies the 2012 author/copyright identification. No fan wiki or actual-play material is used to establish canon.
